questions.explainKo: 정답: ② 추천해 주기. How about ~?는 추천이다. (답지 p.26 Dialog 실전 문제 01)
questions.promptEn:
01 다음 대화의 밑줄 친 부분의 의도로 가장 적절한 것은?

A: Can you recommend a good mystery novel for me?
B: <u>How about The Secret Key? I think it's the best.</u>

questions.explainKo: 정답: ④. Which do you prefer?에 대한 응답으로 추천은 적절하지 않다. (답지 p.26 Dialog 실전 문제 02)
questions.promptEn:
02 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?

A: Which do you prefer, the tie or the scarf?
B: ______
choices: I prefer the tie to the scarf.
I think the tie is good for you.
I like the tie better than the scarf.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ⑤ ⓔ. 순서 ⓒ → ⓐ → ⓔ → ⓑ → ⓓ에서 세 번째는 ⓔ이다. (답지 p.26 Dialog 실전 문제 03)
questions.promptEn:
03 다음 대화 ⓐ~ⓔ를 순서대로 바르게 배열할 때, 세 번째로 오는 것은?

ⓐ Yes, there are. Which do you prefer?
ⓑ Sure! I think the one with the cloud pattern would look great on your phone.
ⓒ I need a smartphone case. But there are so many cases here!
ⓓ I like that one, too. I'll get it then. Thank you!
ⓔ Hmm... I'm not sure. Can you recommend one?

questions.ruleKo: 빈칸은 그 칸의 말만, 문장 문제는 문장 전체를 쓰세요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 빈칸이나 문장을 쓰시오. 빈칸은 그 칸의 말만, 문장 문제는 문장 전체를 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: Which ones do you like? (답지 p.26 Dialog 실전 문제 04)
questions.promptEn:
04 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 우리말에 맞도록 괄호 안의 단어를 이용하여 다섯 단어로 영작하시오.
(ones, like)

B: Jisu, what are you doing?
G: I'm looking at socks. I want to buy a pair.
B: <u>ⓐ너는 어떤 게 마음에 들어?</u>
G: I like the ones with the red hearts, but there are two types.
B: ⓑ ______
G: Um... I prefer the long ones to the short ones. So, I'll take this pair.

06 위 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

B: Jisu, what are you doing?
G: I'm looking at socks. I want to buy a pair.
B: Which ones do you like?
G: I like the ones with the red hearts, but there are two types.
B: Which do you prefer, the short ones or the long ones?
G: Um... I prefer the long ones to the short ones. So, I'll take this pair.
choices: Jisu is looking for a pair of shoes.
Jisu likes the socks with red hearts.
There is only one type of red heart socks.
Jisu prefers short socks to long socks.
Jisu decided to buy the short socks.

questions.explainKo: 정답: two types of socks. (답지 p.26 Dialog 실전 문제 07)
questions.promptEn:
07 위 대화를 읽고, 질문에 대한 답을 네 단어로 완성하시오.

B: Jisu, what are you doing?
G: I'm looking at socks. I want to buy a pair.
B: Which ones do you like?
G: I like the ones with the red hearts, but there are two types.
B: Which do you prefer, the short ones or the long ones?
G: Um... I prefer the long ones to the short ones. So, I'll take this pair.

Q. Why can't Jisu decide easily?
Because there are ______ with the red hearts.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ② on / on. look good on, try them on. (답지 p.26 Dialog 실전 문제 08)
questions.promptEn:
08 위 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ와 ⓒ에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

W: Hi. Can I help you?
B: Yes, please. I'd like to exchange this green cap. I bought it yesterday, but the color doesn't look good ⓐ ______ me.
W: Okay. Which color would you like instead?
B: ⓑ ______
W: Sure. I think this white one and the brown one are nice. Which do you prefer?
B: I like both. Can I try them ⓒ ______?
W: Of course. You can look in this mirror.
B: Okay.... Oh, I really like this brown one. I'll take it!
W: Okay, I'll get you a new one.
B: Thank you.

questions.promptEn:
12 위 대화의 밑줄 친 (A)와 같은 의미가 되도록 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 쓰시오.

B: Hi, Ginny. Wow! You have a lot of things for sale!
G: Yeah. I brought some things from home. My family doesn't use them anymore.
B: I see. Actually, I need a cup. Can you recommend a good one?
G: Sure. How about a large cup?
B: That would be great.
G: Okay. <u>(A) Which do you prefer</u>, a plastic one or a glass one?
B: I prefer a glass one to a plastic one. How much is the glass one?
G: It's three dollars, but I can (B) ______ you a discount. How about two dollars?
B: That's a good price. Here's the money.

= Which do you ______, a plastic one or a glass one?
